item.title: Arsenal recall two players from loan

item.title: Customs, NDLEA intercept 30 slabs of cocaine at Apapa port
item.description: Officers of the Nigeria Customs Service, NCS, Apapa Area Command, working in partnership with the National Drug Law Enforcement Agency, NDLEA, have intercepted 30 slabs of cocaine aboard the MV Aruna, a Marshall Islands-registered vessel.
